knock.text: Ms. Sokolov? Your sister asked me to come check on you.
Marta? It's Kurt. I'm coming in.

investigate_marta.text: Little boxes made of boxes with boxes inside of them... Have you seen them? The boxes, I mean. They're scary at first. But then you look at them for a moment
Look at the boxes, my little bird. Do you see them?

wake.text: Heyyyy buddyyyy.... You should probably take it slow, a concussion is no joke!
Yeah, you. Who the fuck are you?
I'm Socko! I'm a handy little pal! Who are you?
Shouldn't have stood up so fast.

door_locked.text: Wow, thanks. I never would have guessed.

wardrobe_hole.text: I know that I can do this!
Ooh! Ooh! And I can smell important stuff! Go this way!

balcony.text: To my recollection, typically there's more to the world than a sticky note that says "outside"
I wouldn't know, I'm more of an indoor person

pembis_socko.text: This... this is the greatest story I've ever read in my whole life.
How long have you been alive, Socko?
I have existed since before the beginning of time, my dear Kurt.
I somehow find that hard to believe.
No, no, it's true! I hung out with God (whose name is Todd by the way)... and Satan, and...
You can just say you don't know, man.
I have no idea how long I've been alive, Kurt.
